messages:
Dana: Aperture wants a multi-region POC next Tue 09:00 PT. Goal: sustained 480 qps for 40m (mix ~60% chat, 40% embeddings) with three 30s microbursts to 1.5k qps. Need runbook, cost ballpark, and short security note for their infosec.
Olu: model pin + quant? are they on Dedicated or Private?
Dana: Dedicated primary in us-east-1, eu-west-1 as failover. Pin to rdx/multiwork-v3 (4-bit where supported). Fallback to rdx/multiwork-compat. Prefix caching ON, TTL=300s. Warm-up: 15m gentle ramp to 480 qps.
Priyanka: ops recs: use 4 nodes (A100-equivalent) with autoscale min=3 max=10. Split batching: embeddings batch=128, chat batch=32. Route preference: region=us-east then eu-west. Circuit-breaker soft-reject at 1.8s, hard reject at 3s. Disable preemption for the window.
Marco: quick runbook snippet for bench engineers:
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# multi-region ramp test
rdx-stress --mix chat:0.6,embed:0.4 \
  --target 480 --ramp 00:15:00 --duration 00:40:00 \
  --burst 1500:00:00:30 --model rdx/multiwork-v3 --quant 4bit \
  --cache-ttl 300 --prefer-region us-east-1 --failover-region eu-west-1
```
Dana: dry-run yesterday numbers: chat p50=58ms p95=220ms p99=620ms; embeds p50=18ms p95=70ms p99=160ms. Microbursts caused queueing and a 4% 5xx bump when queue >2s. Prefix cache and smaller chat batch helped.
OpsBot: deployment rdx/multiwork-v3-quant4 started by Marco at 1839999001 :rocket:
Olu: cost ballpark for quote? buyer needs approval for infra spend today.
Priyanka: rough calc: assume avg tokens per chat response=6, embeddings billed per call. Estimated token-equivalent: 480 qps * 2400s * 0.6 * 6 = 4,147,200 tokens. At blended rate $0.00039/token => ~$1,616. Embedding calls (0.4 * 480 * 2400 = 460,800 calls) at $0.00015/embed => ~$69. Ops/support, dashboarding, multi-region egress overhead => round to $2.2k for the POC. We'll itemize in email.
LegalBot: NDA signed; they requested an annex limiting log retention and a statement about telemetry (mTLS for metrics ingest). Legal will draft the annex.
Dana: infosec also asked if we can enable mutual TLS for their metrics/trace forwarder and if client certs are required. Ops, can we support during the window?
Marco: yes, we can enable mTLS for the push endpoint for their IPs. Need client certs uploaded 48h before run. I'll add an allowlist: 34.210.3.0/28.
Priyanka: any enterprise blockers? SOC2 copy ready (redacted). HSM not needed for POC. Potential blocker: they want per-request redaction of PII in traces  we will redact and only share aggregated metrics.
Dana: green to go once certs uploaded and allowlist set. Action items: Marco->deploy + dashboard + mTLS + allowlist, Priyanka->formal quote, LegalBot->NDA annex. Post-run debrief scheduled 30m after test. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
